card.name: Limits and impossibility claims in technical explanations
card.fires_on: Words in technical or mathematical explanations where a limit or impossibility is being stated, such as 'no way', 'no wind turbine can', 'nothing you can do', or a proof about all items in a list.

modes.label: Impossibility phrasing
modes.description: Words right after 'no' or 'nothing' that state something cannot be done.

modes.description: Words in 'all' or 'any proposed' statements, or proof arguments about sets such as the reals.

card.writes: It pushes toward words of extremes and inability, such as 'worst', 'cannot' and '无法', and away from 'practical'.
card.plain: It fires in technical text that says something is impossible or covers every case, such as 'there is no way' or 'nothing you can do'.
